south, the Bab al-Mandeb Strait"},{"start":41.23,"end":43.51,"text":"separates Yemen from Djibouti, a passage"},{"start":43.51,"end":45.72,"text":"barely 20 miles wide."},{"start":45.8,"end":47.65,"text":"Together, these two choke points carry"},{"start":47.65,"end":49.59,"text":"roughly 10 percent of world trade and"},{"start":49.59,"end":51.9,"text":"around 8 percent of global liquefied"},{"start":51.97,"end":53.1,"text":"natural gas."},{"start":53.14,"end":55.09,"text":"When both are closed, there is no"},{"start":55.35,"end":57.5,"text":"practical shortcut between Europe and"},{"start":57.5,"end":57.89,"text":"Asia."},{"start":58.12,"end":59.8,"text":"That is the definition we need."},{"start":59.84,"end":61.78,"text":"A choke point is where a narrow passage"},{"start":62.05,"end":63.99,"text":"becomes the only affordable route, and"},{"start":63.99,"end":66.74,"text":"where a small disruption becomes a global"},{"start":67.01,"end":67.44,"text":"price."},{"start":67.48,"end":69.43,"text":"And this disruption is not small."},{"start":69.56,"end":71.77,"text":"Ships that used to transit Suez and Bab"},{"start":71.77,"end":74.2,"text":"al-Mandeb now sail around the Cape of Good"},{"start":74.2,"end":74.77,"text":"Hope."},{"start":74.82,"end":77.72,"text":"That route adds roughly 8,500 nautical"},{"start":77.72,"end":80.16,"text":"miles on a round trip between Asia and"},{"start":80.16,"end":82.14,"text":"Europe, about 10 extra days."},{"start":82.24,"end":85.13,"text":"Suez container traffic is running near 60"},{"start":85.13,"end":87.7,"text":"percent below 2023 levels."},{"start":87.74,"end":90.69,"text":"The Canal Authority is losing toll revenue"},{"start":90.76,"end":91.92,"text":"it counted on."},{"start":91.96,"end":93.9,"text":"Container rates on Asia-Europe lanes are"},{"start":94.17,"end":95.92,"text":"running far above pre-crisis levels, and"},{"start":95.96,"end":98,"text":"tanker war risk premiums have jumped,"},{"start":98,"end":100.03,"text":"insurers are pricing the chance that the"},{"start":100.08,"end":102.36,"text":"next strike finds its target."},{"start":102.4,"end":104.08,"text":"That is why markets care."},{"start":104.12,"end":106.37,"text":"A choke point closure does not just delay"},{"start":106.37,"end":106.93,"text":"ships."},{"start":107,"end":109.46,"text":"It raises the cost of every voyage, every"},{"start":109.46,"end":111.2,"text":"contract, every shelf."},{"start":111.24,"end":113.14,"text":"So what would reopen the Red Sea?"},{"start":113.18,"end":115.47,"text":"The honest answer is deterrence, not"},{"start":115.47,"end":116.32,"text":"distance."},{"start":116.36,"end":117.88,"text":"The detour can be survived."},{"start":117.92,"end":119.78,"text":"The question is whether enough naval"},{"start":119.78,"end":122.12,"text":"force, convoy protection, and negotiated"},{"start":122.12,"end":124.63,"text":"restraint can make the Bab al-Mandeb safe"},{"start":124.63,"end":125.71,"text":"enough to use."},{"start":125.76,"end":127.7,"text":"The United States and allies have struck"},{"start":127.97,"end":130.24,"text":"Houthi targets before, and the EU's naval"},{"start":130.24,"end":132.5,"text":"forces have run escorts for years."},{"start":132.56,"end":135.11,"text":"But the Houthis do not need to sink ships"},{"start":135.11,"end":135.8,"text":"to win."},{"start":135.84,"end":137.78,"text":"They only need to keep enough uncertainty"},{"start":138.05,"end":139.87,"text":"alive that insurers raise premiums and"},{"start":139.94,"end":142.32,"text":"companies keep their vessels on the long"},{"start":142.41,"end":143.04,"text":"route."},{"start":143.08,"end":145.01,"text":"The signal to watch is not the next"},{"start":145.29,"end":145.82,"text":"headline."},{"start":145.88,"end":147.56,"text":"It is the behavior underneath it."},{"start":147.6,"end":149.55,"text":"Watch whether transit counts through Bab"},{"start":149.71,"end":151.38,"text":"al-Mandeb start climbing again."},{"start":151.42,"end":153.68,"text":"Watch whether war risk premiums fall."},{"start":153.72,"end":156.02,"text":"Watch whether the major carriers MERSC,"},{"start":156.02,"end":158.32,"text":"MSC, Hapagloid return their services to"},{"start":158.32,"end":160.46,"text":"Suez or keep them on the Cape."},{"start":160.56,"end":162.41,"text":"If the detour becomes the permanent"},{"start":162.41,"end":164.48,"text":"default, the Red Sea is not a temporary"},{"start":164.48,"end":165.21,"text":"disruption."},{"start":165.4,"end":167.02,"text":"It is a new cost layer in the global"},{"start":167.04,"end":168.89,"text":"economy, one that every importer,"},{"start":168.91,"end":171.8,"text":"exporter, and consumer eventually pays."},{"start":171.84,"end":173.78,"text":"Two straights, one question."},{"start":173.88,"end":175.56,"text":"Can the Red Sea reopen?"},{"start":175.6,"end":177.32,"text":"The answer is not yet."},{"start":177.36,"end":179.95,"text":"And in 2026, the world is still paying the"},{"start":179.95,"end":181.94,"text":"price of the detour while it waits."}]
